info.description: The HTTP API of the PS5Upload engine: everything the app does with a console. No authentication, by the owner's decision: the engine answers this computer and the addresses in PS5UPLOAD_ALLOW_IP. See API.md for guards, errors and how long calls work. This file is generated by `cargo run -p ps5upload-apidoc`; do not edit it.

GET /api/logs/level.description: One level model for the app, the engine and the PS5 helper: error, warn, info, debug, trace. `level` is the global level, `categories` the per-category overrides, `effective` what each category writes now, `until_ms` when a raise above info ends (null when nothing is raised), `category_list` every category with what it covers.

GET /api/logs/recent.summary: The engine's newest log lines, by level, category and time
GET /api/logs/recent.description: Oldest first. `level=debug` keeps debug and everything more severe; `category` takes names separated by commas; `since_ms` (Unix ms) and `since_seq` (a line's `seq`, as `next_seq` answers) keep only newer lines; `limit` keeps the newest (default 200, at most 2000). Secrets are taken out of every line when it is written.

POST /mcp.summary: The MCP endpoint: one JSON-RPC message per request

PUT /api/logs/level.summary: Set the log levels: global, per category, and how long a raise lasts
PUT /api/logs/level.description: Anything above info (globally or for a category) is a raise: it lasts `minutes` (default 60) or until `until_ms`, at most a day, then falls back to info by itself. `categories` replaces the overrides, or with `merge: true` changes only the categories named (null drops one). `reset: true` starts from info with no overrides. The engine keeps the setting on disk and hands it to the app and every helper it talks to.
